content: jsdom-on-Workers is the central D7-05 spike risk. nodejs_compat flag enables node:fs/http/net/dns(partial). isomorphic-dompurify 3.22.0 pulls jsdom@28+ (ESM-only); documented ERR_REQUIRE_ESM issue #394 in CommonJS envs (Lem Reader is ESM type:module so may not apply). jsdom canvas deps + native bits may not work on Workers. DOMPurify itself is documented as not-yet-Web-Worker-compatible per isomorphic-dompurify README. linkedom/worker export exists for Worker envs but linkedom explicitly lacks DOM spec compliance (no live collections) — DOMPurify-on-linkedom is UNVALIDATED; the mXSS regression suite gates linkedom promotion. clearWindow() needed for long-running Workers.
